title: Pawn Wedge Mate
setup: Your pawn on b6 sits right in front of Black's king, and Black's own pawns stand on a7 and b7.
hint: Black's pawns block two squares and your pawn guards the third. The rook needs the back rank.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is a back-rank mate with a quiet pawn assist. The pawn on b6 gives no check, but it covers c7, the one square the rook cannot reach.

{{Rg8#}} checks along the eighth rank. a8 and c8 are on the rook's line, a7 and b7 hold Black's own pawns, and c7 is covered by your pawn. Nothing can block.

When a king is stuck behind two pawns, look for a pawn of yours that covers the third square.
